notes.title: DevBrief#4 - Corona, 0.3 and beyond
notes.notes:
Hello fellow sys-admin'ers!

[u][b]COVID-19[/b][/u]

First of all we want to say that we hope you and your families are all safe. 

The current crisis regarding the COVID-19 virus situation has really changed the way we live, work and play, affecting thousands of people around the world. We wish you all the best in coming weeks and months and we are truly sorry for those who have lost loved ones. 

We are currently in lockdown here at CSD towers and we are able to continue working away on our projects but of course we hope that this situation is over as quickly as possible but to borrow a very old phrase, the show must go on. 

[u][b]0.3 - UI Updates[/b][/u]

We are still working on latest batch of update and fixes for the 0.3 but we felt this would be a good oppotunity to show you the latest UI updates.

notes.title: 0.2.8 IS NOW LIVE! - DEVBRIEF#3 - A New Galaxy Is Spawned
notes.notes:
Hello fellow sys-admin'ers! 

I hope you're all having a wonderful weekend, its been another busy one here at CSD towers. We've been flat out working away on the latest batch of updates and fixes to Galactic Management and the 0.2.8 update is a big one!

[u][b]A Galaxy is born...[/b][/u]

Today we started the rollout of the new Galaxy implementation to the public & beta branches, this will be the initial base model that I will be improving over the coming patches. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35935572/b8a61368f4a05adc64fb58b2919b8213fb92fd26.png[/img]

Over the new few releases further improvements will be made to the main map including nebula's & gases along with a few other pieces I'm keeping secret for the moment ;) 

[b][u]If only we had a list of planets....[/u][/b]

One of the major items we've been busy working on is the Planetary List, an overview of your planets and how they are performing in general. This will provide a quick and easy go to for sys-admins to check 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35935572/688ae2dc6ffa78d9cff4c38e259de38a1a3ba1b4.png[/img]

Here players can quickly scroll through the list of planets to view their status, daily income, trade income and other items such as number of factories/shipyards.

[u][b]Logistics Improvements - Moving stuff and making money[/b][/u]

One of the key features of any space management game is trade and logistics, in Galactic Management that is no different but we wanted to add our own little spin on things.
 
Logistics (Transport ships) provide two things...

[u][b]1. Transport Capability[/b][/u]
Not every planet has the resources you need for your factories, sometimes those resources are on the edge of your sector or the star next door. You can use the Source planet logistics to send any resources on daily basis to another planet of your choosing. This will help provide your factories with the resources they need to survive.

[b][u]2. Increase Income[/u][/b]
Transports are expensive so we dont want them sat around doing nothing if the empire doesnt need them. All free capacity is automatically used by the population for their own trading needs/requirements and increases your daily income.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35935572/0e730272776120a6e07982c48cf35779bfee2aab.png[/img]

In 0.2.8, players will receive 2 x Light Transports, total 1000 units of cargo per planet to get them started and they will really help early game. 
Each transfer between planets is limited by the Source Planet Logistics as they are sending it to the destination so dont forget to keep building mines and transports to keep those resources moving.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35935572/99bc832277b9abfc4a78d1c46c79ad40a9267f09.png[/img]

[u][b]Minor Updates[/b][/u]

So as part of our UI improvement plan to make it easier for players to make informed decisions quickly we have implemented two new buttons on the System Information Screen.

The new "Factory Control" and "Logistics" buttons will display the factories assigned to that Planet only, the same applies for the Logistics, only the currently selected planet information will be displayed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35935572/70256c4c7dc714633cc03325f73fbfce87abbe13.png[/img]

[u][b]Factories[/b][/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35935572/eb76b9fe3a2c8e0560d1ffb03da88145e711d505.png[/img]

[u][b]Logistics[/b][/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35935572/7da19390b10c534edde2edf2291651a092ffe0df.png[/img]

[u][b]Decisions[/b][/u]

In Galactic Management you will be faced with some tough and not so tough decisions, the latest UI update for this feature has been added with future improvements in mind.

In later updates, should something "go wrong" you will have 5 options to choose from to "shift the blame" onto something or someone else.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35935572/dd975bca5347decc3be93ef294ba9cea80126fbf.png[/img]

This concludes this developer briefing, we hope you all have a great rest of the weekend!

Take care
CSD

notes.title: DevBrief#2 - Updates ahead!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, we hope you're all having a great week! 

This weeks developer briefing is here and we have some new updates to share with you regarding the UI and how Production Lines have been improved.

[u][b]Catchup[/b][/u]

Since our last Devbrief we've been busy working on the background functionality for the new Shipyards, Refineries, Mines & Farms. 

Each category will have its own manageable "production line" capable of producing a wide variety of products that the Empire deems fit for its needs.

These will be included in the next major patch around about 2 weeks time.

On to the news...

[u][b]Planet Factory List & Star Information UI Improvements[/b][/u]

One of the key aspects of Galactic Management revolves around the Production Lines and their management. We have now added a new screen to the Star Info display and add some additional cosmetic improvements to help management each Planets factories.

Here we have the new Star Info display with the "Factory Control" button used to access the list of factories assigned to that planet.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35935572/75d16d058cc58428b2533521450391929b2a0a86.png[/img]

This will help improve the process of managing the many Planets & Production Lines you will need to keep growing your sector.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35935572/6acc980ac1bc6ea5c3730884d2f4ceff8972d1e0.png[/img]

[u][b]Player feedback & Production Output[/b][/u]

We've had some great feedback from players that has really helped to drive the list of 'player requested changes' applied to each update, either through identifying any bugs (not many!) or through feature/functionality suggestions that were already on our list but not fully flushed out yet.

One of the key points we agreed should take priority is how Production Lines work and how they are implemented. The current drawback of the first EA releases was that it was difficult to plan your production lines appropriately and that is why we are focusing more attention on this area to help players make informed decisions easier than ever.

Below is the latest UI for the Production Line configuration, this will provide Players with an overview of the impact their changes will make to their planets production.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35935572/d67009acf9ace9da74e9fbd6ce2421475ef706d8.png[/img]

That concludes DevBrief#2 and we hope you have a great rest of the week!
CSD

notes.title: 0.2.2.2 NOW LIVE!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We hope you're having a great start to the week!

0.2.2.2 is now live and ready for download!

We've managed to pack in new buildings and behaviours along with persistent music volume and the Music Player.

We also buffed a few items such as the Reactors and Life Support Generators to help keep your early settlements away from danger, well, as much as we could ;)

Each new department will support up to 5000 people before it becomes ineffective. Once you are over 5000 people then the positive value of the department will become a negative decrease...look out for those riots!

[b][u]The new buildings include...[/u][/b]

[olist]
[*] Police Department - will reduce your crime daily by 1 point
[*] Health Department - This will increase the general health of the colony 1 point per day
[*] Fire Department - This will increase the health and happiness of the colony but will feature in new improvements coming in later releases
[*] Education Department - This will increase your education by 1 point per day. Education will become a decisive factor in coming releases so dont neglect it!
[/olist]
[b][u]Additional Buildings[/u][/b]

There are some additional buildings being added but currently lack the back-end influence/impact that they will have in later releases. These will be released in the new few weeks as part of the 0.3 release.
[olist]
[*] Spy Network - This will help warn you of any impending revolutions or terrorist attacks
[*] Refinery - This will be a major feature of the resource management and economy gameplay allowing you to combine resources to make alloys & high end metals
[*] Logistics Depot - This will provide a home for your logistics transports which will tie in with the Shipyard coming in the next release.
[/olist]

We hope you all have a great rest of the week!
Take care!

notes.title: Small Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, I hope you're all having a great week!

We're just finalising a minor update for 0.2.2.1, this includes some UI fixes, additional buttons in preparation for 0.2.2.2. This should be released in the next few hours.

We have now added the starting implementation for Fire & Rescue services along with the Refinery. While these buildings are not yet in-game the inital button positioning is now completed.

Both these items are due to be released in 0.2.2.3. along with Police, Health and Education departments.

We also added in further Events such as the food shortage/famine to accompany the many dangers and requests looming around the universe.

The biggest noticeable update in this small update is the Notifcations
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35935572/45912ca575a932576efb94919086147952bfc7aa.png[/img]

You will now receive updates when a planet's resources are running low, this will help you take action before things get "too crazy" ;)

Have a great rest of the week!

notes.title: DevBrief#1 - The Early Access Adventure Begins!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, we hope you're all settling into 2020 with ease.

This is our first developer briefing for Galactic Management and hails a key milestone in the games development.

[u][b]Thank you[/b][/u]

We would first like to say thank you from the bottom of our hearts to those who have already purchased Galactic Management, we truly appreciate your support and hope to reward you in the coming months with some great surprises.

Since we launched our inital EA release on Friday we've already had some really excellent feedback and taken this on board using it to drive our first update/patch as a result of those responses. This resulted in our first released feature to the live EA build. 

[u][b]New feature[/b][/u]

Our first new feature is the [b]inter-star traffic[/b] which we will be progressing this week to help provide that living-breathing galaxy that we hope will help players immerse themselves into GalMgmt. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35935572/6d9ef867f66ecaccd598cf8ea0f44872d875d4be.png[/img]

[u][b]Our plan for this week[/b][/u]

This week we will focus on adding more content and buildings to the current release along with UI improvements. Some additions will be made to the Player Profile and also the Help pages.
We will also be looking at introducing the Music Player towards early next week.

This concludes our first Developer Briefing, we hope you all have a wonderful week!
Thanks
CSDdev
